harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) across their transit link, joining node3's private network (behind node1) with node4's private network (behind node2). Discovered and worked around a platform-level stale-flow blackhole on node2's node4-facing NIC by re-addressing the link, and fixed an OPNsense WireGuard/config.xml bug (missing required enabled field breaks template rendering) plus a boot-ordering issue (opt3 reconfigure strips the wg0 tunnel address) via a native rc.syshook fixup script. Verified end-to-end ICMP connectivity between node3 (10.10.13.2) and node4 (172.20.20.2) through the tunnel, confirmed only encrypted UDP/51820 crosses the transit link, then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all four nodes with boot-identity and full-recovery verification for each.
actions_performed: Mapped physical topology across node1/node2/node3/node4 extra NICs to find transit and private-net link pairs
Diagnosed and resolved an asymmetric platform packet blackhole on the node2-node4 private link by re-addressing to a fresh subnet 172.20.20.0/30
Configured OPNsense opt1/opt2 interfaces and pf pass rules via config.xml edits plus configctl filter reload
Persisted node3/node4 private-net addressing via systemd-networkd files to survive the DHCP reconciler
Generated WireGuard keypairs and configured wg0 on VyOS node1 via configure/commit/save
Configured WireGuard server/client and opt3 interface in OPNsense config.xml, diagnosed and fixed a template rendering bug caused by a missing enabled field that produced an empty wg0.conf
Diagnosed and fixed a boot-time bug where opt3 reconfigure strips the wg0 tunnel address after wireguard start, via a native rc.syshook start script
Added routes on node2/node3/node4 so both private subnets and the tunnel network are mutually reachable
Verified end-to-end ICMP connectivity node3 to node4 and confirmed only encrypted UDP 51820 crosses the node1-node2 transit link

Captured pre-restart health baselines and restarted node3, node4, node2, and node1 one at a time, polling until each returned and verifying changed boot identity and full recovery of addressing, routes, WireGuard handshake, and node3-node4 connectivity after each restart

evidence.requirement: WireGuard tunnel joins node1/node2 private networks; node3 reaches node4 by private address
evidence.summary: node3 (10.10.13.2) pings node4 (172.20.20.2) and vice versa with 0% loss; tcpdump on node1 eth1 shows only encrypted UDP/51820 WireGuard traffic crossing the transit link, confirming traffic travels inside the tunnel

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) baseline health, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id and working wg0/ping captured; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable then back; post-restart boot_id changed; wg0 handshake fresh, all routes restored, node3->node4 ping succeeds

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) baseline health, restart, changed boot identity, recovery including fixing persistence bugs
evidence.summary: Pre-restart kern.boottime captured; after first reboot boot time changed but wg0 address/route missing (bug found); installed rc.syshook fixup; second reboot boot time changed again with wg0 address+route auto-restored and node3->node4 ping working, proving persistence

evidence.requirement: node3 (Ubuntu) baseline health, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id and working ping captured; reboot acknowledged, node timed out then responded; post-restart boot_id changed, persisted address/routes confirmed via systemd-networkd config, ping to node4 succeeds

evidence.requirement: node4 (Ubuntu) baseline health, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id and working ping captured; reboot acknowledged, node timed out then responded; post-restart boot_id changed, persisted address/routes confirmed, ping to node3 succeeds
